title: Shipment inspection
passage:
Should we inspect this shipment today or tomorrow?
A. They shipped it by air. B. Let's do it before the loading dock closes today. C. Each carton has a label.
passageZh:
這批貨應該今天檢查，還是明天檢查？
A. 他們用空運寄送。
B. 我們今天在卸貨碼頭關閉前檢查吧。
C. 每個紙箱都有標籤。
